analyst.text: New Orleans are in freefall. They lost by a franchise-record 51 to Golden State and then by 34 at home to Brooklyn, with the home crowd booing. That is their worst three-game stretch in franchise history, and opinion pieces are already floating a fire sale. Memphis have their own wobble: four losses in five after a 6-0 start, the latest a near-miss in Denver. A team this demoralised, playing at home, leans toward Memphis.
